hero.title: Your Muslim life, organized.
hero.subtitle: Prayer times, a planner built around your day, habits that actually stick, halal discovery near you, and an assistant that turns intentions into plans. One calm, private place.

features.title: Everything your day needs
features.subtitle: Built for the way Muslim life actually works — around five daily anchors, not around a to-do list.

prayer.title: Prayer, always in view
prayer.body: Accurate times calculated for your city, method and madhab. Track each prayer with one tap, privately.

planner.title: A planner that knows your day
planner.body: Daily and weekly planning that sits alongside your prayers instead of ignoring them.

habits.title: Habits that last
habits.body: Quran, adhkar, exercise, sleep — or anything you invent. Streaks that encourage without shaming.

discovery.title: Halal life, nearby
discovery.body: Restaurants, butchers, bookstores and modest fashion — with member-only deals.

assistant.title: An assistant that plans with you
assistant.body: Travelling to Istanbul? Preparing for Ramadan? Get a real checklist you can drop straight into your planner.

privacy.title: Yours alone
privacy.body: Your worship is never public, never social, never ranked against anyone. Export or delete it whenever you like.

plannerSection.title: Plan the week you meant to have
plannerSection.body: Tasks, goals and habits in one view. Move things between days, see where the week actually went, and start again without guilt.
plannerSection.point3: Gentle streaks and a weekly review

assistantSection.title: From intention to a real plan
assistantSection.body: Describe what's coming up and get a structured plan you can edit and save — not a wall of text.
assistantSection.disclaimer: Muslim Life Assistant helps you organise your life. It is not a scholar and does not issue religious rulings.
assistantSection.example1: I'm travelling to Istanbul next week
assistantSection.example2: Help me build a Ramadan schedule
assistantSection.example3: I'm getting married in six months

discoverySection.title: Find halal life around you
discoverySection.body: Discover halal places and deals near you. During early access the listings shown are demonstration data, clearly labelled; real partner listings are added city by city.

premium.title: Muslim Life Premium
premium.body: Unlimited habits and saved places, more assistant messages, the plan generators and member-only deals.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.a1: Yes. The free plan includes prayer times and tracking, the daily planner, five habits, ten saved places, ten assistant messages a month and standard deals. Premium adds unlimited habits and saved places, 500 assistant messages a month, the plan generators and member-only deals.
faq.q2: How accurate are the prayer times?
faq.a2: Times are calculated astronomically from your city's coordinates, using the calculation method and madhab you choose. Always check them against your local mosque.
faq.q3: Is my prayer and habit data private?
faq.a3: Yes, and structurally so. There is no public profile, no feed and no leaderboard anywhere in Muslim Life. You can export or delete your data at any time.
faq.a4: No, and it never will be. It helps you plan trips, Ramadan, life events and your week. On anything involving religious interpretation it tells you that scholars differ and points you to qualified people.
faq.a5: During early access most listings are clearly labelled demo data used to show how discovery works. Real partner listings are added city by city and are never labelled demo.
faq.a6: Yes. Cancel from your settings in two clicks and keep Premium until the end of the period you've paid for.

cta.title: Start with today.
cta.subtitle: One prayer, one habit, one honest plan. That's how it begins.

footer.disclaimer: Muslim Life is a lifestyle and productivity product. It does not provide religious rulings, medical, legal or financial advice.

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.subtitle: Take a copy, clear what you've tracked, or leave entirely. All three are yours to decide.

export.title: Download your data
export.body: A single JSON file with everything you've created: prayers, habits, tasks, planner, reflections, saved places and your assistant conversations.
export.excluded: It does not contain passwords, session tokens, security records or anyone else's data.
export.rateLimited: You've already requested an export recently. You can request another in {hours} hours.

activity.title: Clear your activity
activity.body: Removes what you've tracked while keeping your account: prayer logs, habit history, tasks, planner blocks and reflections.
activity.warning: This cannot be undone, and it is not the same as deleting your account.
activity.confirmBody: Your account, settings and subscription stay. Your logged history does not. Type CLEAR to confirm.

account.title: Delete your account
account.body: Removes your account and personal data. Some records are kept because the law requires it — invoices, and a minimal security log.
account.confirmBody: Type DELETE to confirm. You'll be signed out everywhere and have {graceDays} days to change your mind before anything is removed.
account.blockedBilling: You have an active paid subscription. Cancel it first — we won't delete an account while a provider can still charge it.
account.pendingBody: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {date}. Nothing has been removed yet.
account.cancelled: Your account will not be deleted.
